career_ladder.note: Specialist Cadre Officers (SCO / SO) in State Bank of India are recruited across specialized domains including Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Credit Analysis, Risk Management, Law, and Wealth Management. Direct entry occurs at Junior Management Grade Scale I (JMGS-I) or Middle Management Grade Scale II/III (MMGS-II / MMGS-III), with career progression through Senior Management and Top Executive grades.

steps.years: Entry level for Scale I specialists (probation 2 yrs)
steps.source_label: State Bank of India — Central Recruitment & Promotion Department (CRPD) Specialist Cadre Officer Regulations

steps.designation: Assistant General Manager (AGM — SMGS-V) / Deputy General Manager (DGM — TEGS-VI)

exam_scheme.note: Selection for SBI Specialist Cadre Officers varies by role and grade. For exam-based posts (e.g. Assistant Manager Systems, Credit Analysts), selection consists of an Online Written Test followed by an Interview, with merit weightage of 70% for the written test and 30% for the interview. For senior lateral/specialist roles, selection is based on shortlisting and Interview (100 marks). In the objective written test, a penalty of 1/4th (0.25) mark applies for every incorrect answer.

stages.stage_name: Stage I: Online Written Test (General Aptitude & Professional Knowledge)
stages.source_label: State Bank of India — CRPD Specialist Cadre Officers Notification (Selection Process & Syllabus)

papers.paper_name: General Aptitude: Reasoning Ability, Quantitative Aptitude & English Language
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying only; candidates must score minimum qualifying marks to have Professional Knowledge evaluated

papers.paper_name: Professional Knowledge (Domain / Specialist Area: IT, Law, Risk, Finance)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit ranking based on Professional Knowledge score

stages.source_label: State Bank of India — CRPD Specialist Cadre Officers Notification (Interview Stage)

papers.paper_name: Personal Interview (SBI Local Head Offices / Corporate Centre)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying marks category-wise; combined with Stage I (70:30 weightage)

financial_package.note: Specialist Cadre Officers receive pay and perks under the Bipartite Settlement / SBI Officers Service Rules. For Scale I (JMGS-I), starting basic pay is ₹48,480 in scale ₹48480-2010/7-62550-2340/2-67230-2680/7-85920; for Scale II (MMGS-II), starting basic pay is ₹64,820; for Scale III (MMGS-III), basic pay starts at ₹85,920. In addition, SBI provides four additional increments to direct officer recruits as per institutional policy.
financial_package.pay_source_label: State Bank of India — CRPD Notification (Salary & Emoluments for Specialist Cadre Officers)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Scale I entry basic pay of ₹48,480 plus applicable Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (or leased accommodation up to city limits), Special Allowance, City Compensatory Allowance, and Location Allowance; net in-hand factors in defined pension and PF contributions.
official_perks: Bank leased residential accommodation or House Rent Allowance in major commercial centers
Comprehensive medical benefits (100% for employee, 75% for dependent family) and Group Insurance
Defined contribution pension scheme under National Pension System (NPS) and Provident Fund
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) / Home Travel Concession and leave encashment provisions
Concessional staff loan schemes for housing, car, and personal needs, plus fuel and entertainment allowances

competition_benchmarks.note: SBI notifies Specialist Cadre Officers periodically through multiple advertisements (CRPD/SCO series) each year across regular and contractual tracks. Annual vacancies typically range from 400 to 1,500 posts across specialized roles.
